div.h1: 5 PRIVATE ACTORS + INSOLVENCY ADMINISTRATOR — PROFESSIONAL-KNOWLEDGE CHECKPOINT COMMUNICATED TO PwC IN 2016
div.p: ONE ASSET · EXPRESS INSTRUCTION TO PURSUE THE CRIMINAL ROUTE · PwC–IA CONTACT · QUESTIONS ABOUT THE SAME PERIMETER

div.div: Roles and statements are source-controlled. This graphic identifies documentary questions; it does not determine guilt.

div.p: Documented administrator; later roles involving control, accounts and information must be proved act by act.
Documented as representative; later access and security roles require dated evidence.
Documented in Community/Pamanil-perimeter communications; scope and knowledge remain open.
Documented entry into the perimeter; to be reconciled with HNT/MYND continuity and the architectural role.
Legal, insolvency and access functions must remain separate and be proved individually.

ul.li: The client expressly instructed PwC to pursue the criminal route.
PwC recorded: “Tomamos nota de vuestra decisión”.
PwC later confirmed direct contact with the Insolvency Administrator.

div.p: Contemporaneous client determination/instruction and PwC knowledge. It is not an independent PwC conclusion that any named person committed an offence.
